Name: Dungeon Cookbook
Author: Ishrmla
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]这是以《迷宫饭》为原型制作的模组，添加了一系列新的自定义菜谱、魔物及新的掉落物、新的果树、新的农场动物、装备以及一个新的地点等等！[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod is based on *Delicious in Dungeon* and adds a host of new features, including custom recipes, monsters with unique drops, fruit trees, farm animals, equipment, a new location, and more![/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]下载到Mods文件夹解压就好！[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Just download it to the Mods folder and extract it![/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]在矿洞会生成新的魔物，打败它们收集材料，烹饪迷宫美食，出售魔物材料和美食换得丰厚的报酬（以及某些神奇的装备和工具），种植新的果树，养育一种新的农场动物（魔物？）......[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]请注意，要从出货箱出售一些魔物材料才可以收到一些神秘的礼物邮件！[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]哦，为了配合我的魔物我更改了游戏原版苍蝇的音效^-^[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]New monsters will spawn in the mines; defeat them to gather materials, cook dungeon delicacies, and sell both the monster materials and the food for handsome rewards (including some magical gear and tools). You can also plant new fruit trees and raise a new type of farm animal (or is it a monster?)...
Please note: you need to sell certain monster materials via the shipping bin to receive mysterious gifts in the mail!
Oh, and I’ve changed the sound effect for the game's original flies to better match my monsters! ^-^[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]需要前置模组：[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI
content patcher[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]farm type manager这个用来在我的自定义地点中生成相应的物品[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]monster variety这个用来添加新的魔物[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Mail Framework Mod这个用来自定义一些邮件[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]aedenthorn.SoundTweaker更改音效（苍蝇）[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]GenericModConfigMenu可以在游戏内选择是否开启矿洞怪物替换，在一些特殊任务进行的时候，也许会需要这个来关闭我的魔物替换开关，我的魔物替换会影响掉落物[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]TrinketTinker这个增加自定义跟随小精灵[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]You'll need:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI
Content Patcher
Farm Type Manager (used to spawn specific items in my custom locations)
Monster Variety (used to add new monsters)
Mail Framework Mod (used to customize certain mail messages)
aedenthorn.SoundTweaker (modifies sound effects, such as the buzzing of flies)
GenericModConfigMenu (allows you to toggle the mine monster replacement feature in-game; you might need this to disable the replacement during certain special quests, as my mod alters monster drops)
TrinketTinker (adds custom companion sprites)[/color]

Downloads.Description: 添加了模组菜单的i18n中文和英语的翻译内容；添加了一个遗漏的食谱；修改了史莱姆干以及矮人铜锅制作物品分类，修复了这些物品在烹饪图鉴显示错误的问题，现在它们变成了工匠物品，会出现在出货图鉴中而不是烹饪图鉴。
